App+1｜ArkFlow：满足你的卡面收集癖，给信用卡做个卡面墙
items.summary_en: ArkFlow is a solo-developed bank card collection and asset management app built in two months using Codex and Claude Code, gaining 1,000 downloads within its first seven days. Despite the developer investing heavily in a "freedom profile" system with 60 growth stages and gender-specific avatars, users overwhelmingly preferred the card-visual features—uploading real card faces, three stacking/slide interaction styles (layered, focus, and Apple Wallet-style), and a customizable card wall. Accounts and data are stored locally with iCloud sync, Face ID protection, and no bank integration; the target users are those managing dozens of cards, investment, and multi-currency accounts in one place.

items.summary_en: In just six months, family humanoid robot company Future不远 Robotics has completed three funding rounds totaling over 1 billion yuan, with ByteDance, Huichuan Investment, and nearly 10 other investors participating. The company has already delivered robots to over 500 families across China for household tasks including cooking, cleaning, and companionship, and recently demonstrated end-to-end pasta cooking with its second-generation self-developed robot F2 powered by the WAM world action model. Founded in 2022, the company pursued a full-stack self-research strategy over three years before launching its first commercial product F1 in 2025, now employing approximately 200 core engineers

directions.name: 免费API聚合编程助手
directions.description: 聚合50+免费/低成本API提供商，为独立开发者提供一键切换模型、自动故障转移的智能编码代理工具
directions.description_en: Aggregates 50+ free and low-cost API providers into a smart coding agent with one-click model switching and automatic failover for indie developers
directions.target_user: 预算有限的独立开发者和小型创业团队
directions.target_user_en: Indie developers and small startup teams with limited budgets
core_features: 自动在多模型API间智能路由和故障转移
内置RTK流量过滤保护用户数据隐私
支持语音输入辅助编码
core_features_en: Intelligent routing and failover across multiple model APIs
Built-in RTK traffic filtering to protect user data privacy
Voice input support for coding assistance
directions.why_now: GitHub Trending 入选项目 free-claude-code 聚合50个ToS友好API提供商并提供每月1.3B+免费token，社区对低成本AI编程解决方案需求强烈。当前LLM API费用仍是独立开发者最大门槛，该工具精准解决这一痛点。
directions.why_now_en: The GitHub Trending project free-claude-code aggregates 50 ToS-friendly API providers offering 1.3B+ monthly free tokens, with strong community demand for cost-effective AI coding solutions. LLM API costs remain the biggest barrier for indie developers, and this tool precisely addresses this pain point.
directions.monetization: 免费版限流使用，高级版按月订阅解锁优先路由、更多并发和团队功能
directions.monetization_en: Free tier with rate limits, premium subscription unlocks priority routing, more concurrency, and team features

directions.why_now: Uber通过MCP网关实现70%+ Pull Request由AI代理编写、工程师代码产出翻倍，验证了MCP在企业级Agentic Coding中的巨大价值。Tesla Cybercab和Apple Mac Mini发布周期临近，硬件+AI组合趋势升温，开发者亟需工具降低MCP集成门槛。

With Tesla Cybercab and Apple Mac Mini launches approaching, the hardware+AI trend is heating up, and developers urgently need tools to lower MCP integration barriers.
